title: 🏛️ RBI Draft Directions — Daily Net Open Position (NOP) & Basel-Aligned Forex Risk Capital
theme: Forex Risk Management & Basel Capital Standards
summary: RBI proposed revised continuous daily computation of NOP and capital charges for foreign exchange risk effective April 1, 2027, removing separate offshore/onshore NOP and extending rules to SFBs and RRB Authorised Dealers.
